entries.summary: Talaria Web now runs on a TypeScript server (Node 24) with a small Python sidecar for the Hermes Agent; existing sessions, settings, logins, and passkeys carry over without migration.

Install and start Talaria Web with npm: npm install -g @maudecode/talaria-web, then talaria-web (with talaria-web ctl for daemon control). The Python launcher, start.sh, ctl.sh, and the pip wheel are gone.
The API is defined once as a contract shared by the server, the browser, and the app, with a generated OpenAPI document; a few unused routes were removed.
Self-update restarts only the server worker once active chats finish, and the Agent update runs through the sidecar.
Office document preview and save (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) were removed from the workspace browser.
The Edge text-to-speech engine was removed; the browser voice, OpenAI, and ElevenLabs engines remain.
Native Windows startup scripts were removed; Windows is supported through WSL2.
The Nix flake and NixOS module were removed; use the npm package or the container image.
